name: Minnesota

rule.phaseIn: Born after June 30, 2004 from July 1, 2025; after June 30, 2000 from July 1, 2026; after June 30, 1996 from July 1, 2027; after June 30, 1987 from July 1, 2028.
rule.textEn: Minnesota is phasing in a watercraft operator's permit: since July 1, 2026 anyone born after June 30, 2000 needs it for a motorboat over 25 hp or any PWC; the cut-off moves to June 30, 1996 on July 1, 2027 and to June 30, 1987 on July 1, 2028.
rule.textEs: Minnesota está ampliando por etapas el permiso de operador: desde el 1 de julio de 2026 lo necesita quien nació después del 30 de junio de 2000 para una lancha de más de 25 hp o cualquier moto acuática; la fecha pasa al 30 de junio de 1996 el 1 de julio de 2027 y al 30 de junio de 1987 el 1 de julio de 2028.

minAge.note: Under 12: motorboats under 75 hp only with an accompanying operator; no PWC even with an adult. Any age may run a motor of 25 hp or less without a permit.

exemptions: Motorboat with a motor factory-rated at 25 hp or less (not a PWC).
Visitors 12-26 holding a valid home-state certificate.
nonResident: Visitors with a valid home-state certificate do not need a Minnesota permit.
rental: Since July 1, 2025 nobody under 18 may rent a motorboat or PWC; renters without a permit take a rental operator exam.

sources.quote: Born after the following dates: • June 30, 2004 (effective July 1, 2025) • June 30, 2000 (effective July 1, 2026) • June 30, 1996 (effective July 1, 2027) • June 30, 1987 (effective July 1, 2028)
People of any age can operate a motorboat powered by a motor with a factory rating of 25 horsepower or less without a watercraft operator’s permit or an accompanying operator on board.
Less than 12 years Cannot operate, even with an adult on board.

If you are visiting Minnesota and are between the ages of 12‑26 years and already possess a valid watercraft operator’s certificate/permit issued by your home state, you don’t need to obtain another one from Minnesota.
Effective July 1, 2025, no one under the age of 18 is able to rent or lease a motorboat, including a personal watercraft.
